daily.today_energy: Mercury in Scorpio is pushing you to get real about what you actually want. With Saturn retrograde, old patterns are asking for a second look. Trust your gut—it's sharper than usual.
daily.love: Venus sextile Jupiter is making you feel generous and open-hearted. If you've been holding back, today's the day to show up authentically. Single? Someone notices your vibe.
daily.career: Mars conjunct Jupiter is firing up ambition across the board, but don't overcommit. Your intuition knows what's sustainable. One solid move beats three rushed ones.
daily.health: The Moon in Taurus wants you grounded and fed. Skip the overthinking and prioritize rest, good food, and gentle movement. Your nervous system will thank you.

Big shift: Sun enters Sagittarius Friday, sparking fresh adventure.
weekly.love: Early week tension from Sun square Mars might have you feeling defensive or withdrawn, but don't let it. Midweek blooms beautifully—Venus sextile Jupiter makes you magnetic and genuinely warm. Someone's noticing. By the weekend, the Full Moon illuminates what you actually want, cutting through confusion. Lean into honesty.
weekly.career: Monday brings frustration (Sun square Mars collision), so avoid major decisions or confrontations then. Midweek flips the script—your ideas land better, collaborations spark. The Full Moon Friday brings clarity on a project or goal you've been sitting with. Use this momentum to pitch something or pivot your approach.
